annotations.title: TIA — render a block as readable pseudo-SCL (LAD/FBD)

description: Class R, pure and offline: never calls the serve, so it works with the serve down. Renders ONE SimaticML block export (an exported .xml file, or the xml of tia_export_block) as readable pseudo-SCL, network by network: LAD/FBD contacts, coils, logic boxes, comparators, MOVE/arithmetic, timers, counters, edges and block calls become SCL-like statements; SCL networks are rebuilt from their tokens; STL/GRAPH networks are marked not rendered. A value read by several statements or assigned to several targets is evaluated once: held in an RLO_<UId> temporary (UId of the part producing it) or read back from the first coil that wrote it. A MOVE/arithmetic output read by another part is inlined only when the box is always enabled; otherwise IF <EN> THEN TMP_<UId> := <value>; END_IF; and the reader uses TMP_<UId>, which keeps its previous (stale) value when EN is false. The output or return value of ONE call is TMP_<UId>_<pin> when it has several targets or, for an FC (no instance), when another part reads it or it is negated: bound in the call (pin => TMP_<UId>_<pin>, or TMP_<UId>_<pin> := call(args); for the return value), and targets and readers copy from it; two calls never share one. A call with an instance and one target is direct or read as #inst.pin. An edge (P_TRIG/N_TRIG) runs every scan: used inside an IF <EN> body it is evaluated before the IF (RLO_<UId> := P_TRIG(...);), not conditional on that EN. A negated output pin shows as NOT (a negated instance or call output: a following line target := NOT #t.Q; under the same EN). TYPE#(x) is x read as TYPE: an absolute address of a non-natural type for its size shows its own type (INT#(%MW0)); a comparator, arithmetic box or Inc/Dec casts with the instruction type every operand but a constant, a boolean or one of that type, values forwarded by MOVE, a box or a call too (INT#(RLO_40), INT#(TMP_41)); constants and written places are never cast. What it cannot translate stays visible as (* unsupported: ... *) and is listed in unsupported, as are a duplicate UId, edge memory shared by several edge parts, a negated operand on an S/R/P/N coil and an invalid name or UId: that part is ambiguous, read it in the XML or report it as not reviewed. A network too large to render is marked not rendered and in unsupported (render budget). Hidden and bidirectional characters show as <U+XXXX>. For review only: not importable, layout not preserved, ENO shown as EN (errors not modeled). Returns {text, blocks, unsupported, note}.
